title: Weight & Anthropometry Care Guidance
source: Consensus Statement for Diagnosis of Obesity & Abdominal Obesity in Asian Indians
reviewed_by: Dr. A. Sharma, MD (Endocrinology Review Board)

doctor_tests: Annual height, weight, and waist circumference check
food: Maintain balanced calorie intake with whole foods and adequate protein
low.hospital_guidance: Preventive wellness or primary care clinic.

doctor_tests: Primary care or lifestyle clinic review within 4 weeks
Screen for fasting glucose and lipid profile
exercise: Gradually build up to 200–250 minutes/week of brisk walking + 2 days strength training
food: Replace refined carbs with high-fiber vegetables and lean protein

doctor_tests: Endocrinologist / Bariatric & Metabolic Physician evaluation within 2–4 weeks
Fasting Glucose, HbA1c, Lipid Profile, Liver Function Tests, and Thyroid Profile
exercise: Low-impact joint-friendly activity (walking, water aerobics, stationary cycling) starting slowly
food: Avoid late-night heavy meals and sugar-sweetened drinks
high.hospital_guidance: Multi-specialty hospital with Endocrinology & Clinical Nutrition.
